daemon.description: Whether to run collectl as a background daemon process

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file used when running in daemon mode

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging at startup and for diagnostics

interval.description: Time in seconds between successive data snapshots

dir.description: Directory where log files are stored

compress.description: Whether to compress old log files using gzip

retention.description: Number of days to retain log files before deletion

maxSize.description: Maximum size (in KB) per log file before rotation

custom_format.description: Custom output format specification (only used if format = 'custom'). Example: 'H:1000000000:1000000000:1000000000:1000000000'

optional_features.description: List of optional features to enable (e.g., ['procstat', 'cgroup'])

excluded_devices.description: List of devices or interfaces to exclude from monitoring (e.g., ['lo', 'docker0'] for network)
